DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Nodosum Leprosum (ENL)

Based on your history of working with livestock, the combination of a pruritic rash, and symmetric numbness/tingling in the palms, along with normal systemic labs, this presentation is highly characteristic of ENL. This is a type 2 leprosy reaction that often presents with systemic symptoms like fever, arthralgia, and neuritis. Please confirm if you have noticed any new lumps on your nerves or any recent feverish episodes.
